description: Tracked copies of documents that live under .omc/, which .gitignore:27 ignores. Release gates parse the TRACKED copy — a gate reading an ignored path works locally and fails on the first CI clone (AC-X.7a). scripts/verify/assert-spec-fresh.sh asserts each copy still matches its origin whenever the origin is present, so the copy cannot silently go stale while everyone reads the live document.

sources.why: The acceptance criteria. ac-inventory.ts derives the live AC set from this file and ac-bijection.sh holds the proof table to it, so drift here silently re-scopes the release gate.
The consensus plan, including the S0.4c artifact manifest and the section 3 AC-proof table that docs/ac-proof-table.json is the machine-readable form of.
